## Checklist (Definition of Done)

- [ ] Backend tests pass (`python manage.py test`) and new behaviour has tests
- [ ] `python manage.py makemigrations --check` is clean (migrations committed)
- [ ] Frontend builds (`npm run build`) and lints (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Works on a phone-width screen as well as desktop
- [ ] Validation and error handling for the new inputs
- [ ] Docs / `.env.example` updated if behaviour or configuration changed
